name: Maw
description: Glory and death in battle are two sides of the same coin. For victory, for their next meal, for the thrill of the hunt.

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.description: After attacking, may reroll failures up to twice Maw Rank. Risk losing 2 Hearts on low d6 roll (cannot be reduced).

abilities.name: Burnout
abilities.description: May spend or dedicate Hearts in place of Stamina for attacks (after 1 Stamina dedicated), parries, and dodges.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Slaying a combatant restores 1 Heart (2 Hearts if using natural weapon).
